capabilities.name: Local reviewed execution
capabilities.outcome: Harness-led implementation and independent bounded correction with a final code gate and safe local commit before advancement

capabilities.name: Durable recovery
capabilities.outcome: Replacement coordinator resumes safely from persisted state

capabilities.name: Enforced gates
capabilities.outcome: Invalid evidence or authority never releases dependencies

artifacts.name: Approved manifest and run policy
artifacts.lifecycle: Immutable during active work; explicit revision at safe boundaries only.

artifacts.name: Run/task state and operations
artifacts.lifecycle: Atomic reservations and state versions; reserved/running/terminal/unknown operations; persistent three-correction task counter; invalid requests leave authoritative state unchanged; separate append-only diagnostics allowed.

artifacts.name: Candidate and scope evidence
artifacts.lifecycle: Relevant tracked/untracked bytes and baseline; edits supersede evidence.

artifacts.name: Assignment and actor outcome
artifacts.lifecycle: Bind run/task/flow/operation/role; preserve rejected outcomes as history; no authority from actor claims.

artifacts.name: Verification evidence
artifacts.lifecycle: Command/environment/outcome bound to candidate; superseded records remain historical.

artifacts.name: Review findings and verdict
artifacts.source_of_truth: Independent reviewer outcome admitted by controller
artifacts.lifecycle: Stable findings across cycles; fresh reviewer resolves findings; edits invalidate verdict.

artifacts.name: Acceptance, commit/finalization and intervention records
artifacts.lifecycle: Persist final-gate approval and task-scoped commit intent/receipt; reconcile unknown commit outcomes; release dependencies atomically only after proven commit; idempotent replay; intervention preserves evidence without release.

artifacts.name: Supported harness contract
artifacts.lifecycle: Versioned supported transport, permissions, lifecycle, safe local commit/reconciliation, intervention notification mechanism and limitations.

interfaces.name: Status and reserve
interfaces.contract: Return status and permitted actions; reserve against expected version; enforce authority, single-writer ownership and persistent three-correction limit before launch. Invalid requests leave authoritative state/version and workspace unchanged; separate diagnostic append allowed.

interfaces.name: Launch, wait, cancel and reconcile
interfaces.contract: Use real observed session identity and operation key; no duplicate launch; unknown status blocks; enforce supported permissions. Connect the selected intervention notifier; record delivery failure truthfully.

interfaces.name: Collect, inspect and verify
interfaces.contract: Validate subject, role, provenance and candidate; inspect scope; execute configured checks; reject stale or invalid evidence.

interfaces.name: Final gate, commit, recover and advance
interfaces.contract: Require current configured checks, independent review, approved scope, no blocking findings and no active operation. Persist gate approval and exact-path local commit intent; create/reconcile commit without owner work; then atomically publish completion/release. Unknown or unavailable commit blocks advancement; replay cannot duplicate commit. Refusals return reasons without stopping; unrecoverable outcomes persist intervention and request notification.

invariants.statement: Agent output cannot change authority or required stages.
invariants.verification: Invalid requests leave authoritative state/version and workspace unchanged; optional append-only diagnostics are separate. Valid operational outcomes may change phase/evidence or publish intervention.

invariants.statement: Only one active operation; uncertain liveness blocks new work and acceptance.
invariants.verification: Duplicate launch and real interruption/reconciliation probes.

invariants.statement: Verification and review bind to the accepted candidate.
invariants.verification: Edit tracked/untracked bytes after evidence; acceptance rejects stale evidence.

invariants.statement: Enabled review is fresh, independent and adapter-attributed.
invariants.verification: Same-thread and invented-session rejection; valid independent receipt admitted.

invariants.statement: Initial implementation uses cycle zero; every authorized correction consumes exactly one of three persistent task cycles; no fourth correction.
invariants.verification: Three-cycle task limit across failed-check/review routes; replay, crash and coordinator replacement cannot add or reset cycles; exhaustion requests intervention.

invariants.statement: Only final-gate approval plus a proven task-scoped local commit releases dependencies; all configured current evidence is required.
invariants.verification: Pending/failed/inconclusive/stale evidence or missing/unknown commit blocks release; crash/replay cannot duplicate commit or release; unrelated staged/unstaged owner work preserved.

invariants.statement: Durable records allow recovery without chat history.
invariants.verification: Fresh coordinator reconstructs permitted next action after interruption.

invariants.statement: Omission, pass, failure, stale, blocked and not-run remain distinct.

flows.name: Reviewed task and bounded correction
flows.terminal_outcome: Final-gated task-scoped local commit and released dependencies, or explicit intervention with durable reason

steps.action: Select ready task and reserve enabled preflight/implementation
Execute authorized role and collect outcome
Inspect candidate and execute configured checks
steps.state_transition: terminal -> review-ready or correction-required or recovery/intervention-required

steps.action: Review stable candidate and retain finding identities
steps.state_transition: review-ready -> acceptance-eligible or correction-required or recovery/intervention-required

steps.action: Authorize bounded correction; rerun inspection, verification and fresh review
Recheck final evidence gate; persist commit intent; create/reconcile task-scoped local commit; atomically complete/release and select next eligible task
steps.state_transition: acceptance-eligible -> accepted/pending-commit -> committed/completed -> next ready task or completed run; unavailable/unknown commit -> blocked without release

flows.name: Interruption and coordinator replacement
flows.terminal_outcome: Same valid next action reconstructed, or unknown ownership explicitly blocked

steps.action: Reconcile active/reserved operation and any pending commit before relaunch or finalization retry
Read durable status and collect or resume only permitted operation
steps.state_transition: known terminal -> next permitted phase; unknown -> blocked

flows.name: Policy and evidence rejection
flows.trigger: Invalid request, scope drift, stale evidence, inconclusive outcome or exhausted corrections
flows.terminal_outcome: Structured refusal with unchanged authoritative state, recoverable operational outcome, or persisted intervention; no unauthorized launch/release

steps.action: Refuse invalid requests without authoritative mutation; return reason/permitted alternatives; separate append-only diagnostics allowed
Admit operational failure evidence; recover within authority and three cycles, or persist intervention and notify owner; successful/recoverable cases need no active notification
steps.state_transition: admitted outcome -> recovery/correction; unrecoverable or exhausted -> intervention-required without dependency release

tasks.title: Establish harness boundary
tasks.outcome: Concrete supported adapter contract and capability evidence
tasks.integration_boundary: Selected transport documents launch identity, permissions, cancellation, collection and reconciliation; unsupported requirements explicitly block. Establish safe exact-path local commit/reconciliation and intervention notification support or expose the blocking capability.
tasks.task_planner_context: Resolve Q-001/Q-002 before dependent implementation; inspect actual installed interfaces; no unapproved billable probes.

tasks.title: Expose guarded operations
tasks.outcome: Status and reservation preserve authority, prevent duplicate writers and enforce the persistent three-correction limit
tasks.integration_boundary: Unauthorized, duplicate or stale requests are refused without launch or authoritative state/version change. Persist writer ownership and the three-cycle task counter; final evidence/stage completeness belongs to T-005.
tasks.task_planner_context: Extend current ledger/cursor, fix state-version and reservation semantics; do not create second authority store.

tasks.title: Connect actors and recovery
tasks.outcome: Authorized local actors have durable provenance and safe recovery
tasks.integration_boundary: Operation launch/collect/cancel/reconcile works; crash after launch cannot cause a duplicate writer. Connect intervention notification and truthful delivery-failure reporting.
tasks.task_planner_context: Adapter owns receipts; reviewer content is supplied later by T-004; unknown launch remains blocked; apply actual role permissions.

tasks.title: Complete evidence and correction loop
tasks.outcome: Independent findings drive bounded verified corrections
tasks.integration_boundary: Real fixture correction changes failing check to passing; fresh reviewer admits new candidate; stale result rejected.
tasks.task_planner_context: Reuse verification/Git logic; preserve distinct required skill roles; share correction limit across test/review findings; conservative invalidation. Initial implementation is cycle zero; allow three corrections per task and refuse a fourth; counters survive replacement.

tasks.title: Gate, commit and release dependencies
tasks.outcome: Final-gated candidates are committed locally before dependent work is released
tasks.integration_boundary: Two-task fixture remains blocked until final-gate approval and proven task-scoped local commit; crash/retry cannot duplicate commits/release or absorb unrelated staged/unstaged owner changes. Unknown or unavailable commit blocks advancement.
tasks.task_planner_context: Own final gate, commit intent/receipt and crash reconciliation before atomic completion/release; configured current evidence and final drift check required; no remote effects. Distinguish request refusal from intervention.

tasks.title: Deliver coordinator skill and local proof
tasks.outcome: Usable local workflow with truthful documentation and qualification
tasks.integration_boundary: Fresh coordinator completes or resumes the documented flow; deterministic evidence and separately authorized real harness pilot reported distinctly. Prove task-scoped commit before release, three-cycle persistence and intervention-only notification.
tasks.task_planner_context: Update current skill/references/examples; inspect installer without auto-adding orchestrator; no active installation refresh; preserve review separation.
